resolution: For each state x operation pair select the matching rule with the highest numeric priority. Equal-priority ties are invalid. Wildcard state '*' provides conservative defaults.

states.description: Single-instance compatibility mode; bound Hub/CURRENT healthy; no registry.
Single-instance compatibility mode with pending Hub inputs in global Manager inbox.
Registry document and active selection valid; active Hub/CURRENT activation-eligible.
instances.json exists but the authoritative registry document itself is malformed, conflicting or otherwise unsafe to resolve.
Registry document is valid, but active_instance metadata is missing, malformed or names no registered row.
Registry and active selection resolve, but selected active Hub path is missing.
Registry and active selection resolve, but selected active Hub fails required validation.
Active Hub is healthy; at least one inactive registered Hub is missing.
Active Hub is healthy; at least one inactive registered Hub is corrupt/ineligible.
Registry active while legacy/global Manager inbox contains Hub-owned pending inputs.
Registry active and active instance inbox contains Hub-owned pending inputs.
Manager self-update process boundary while UpdateAll Hub intent remains pending.
Authoritative registry/active write may be durable and post-commit verification is pending or failed.
Registration/switch/rebind target has coherent but non-approved CURRENT.
Target Hub and CURRENT identities/content do not match.

rules.reason: Initialization is legal only in explicitly enumerated states.
Listing must be diagnostic and must not require active Hub health when the registry document itself can be read safely.
Switch is legal only when target validation/recovery semantics are explicit.
Registration requires a valid registry and activation-eligible target.
Registered Genesis requires a healthy registry and explicit commit path.
Binding/rebinding is legal only where requested-target semantics are explicit.
Manager update is global and must not retarget or mutate Hub lifecycle state.
Hub update must execute against captured single/instance context.
UpdateAll combines global Manager update with captured Hub intent.
CURRENT repair is instance/single-Hub lifecycle work.
Doctor must diagnose invalid/missing state without requiring mutation.
Candidate transport is bound to active/single Hub CURRENT and inbox.
Candidate transport restore is bound to active/single Hub CURRENT and inbox.
Bootstrap may activate only after the exact Hub/CURRENT and compatibility state are freshly activation-eligible at commit boundary.
Pending reachable Hub inputs must be accounted for before discovery ownership changes.
Existing registry may report already initialized only after registry and active selection fully resolve.
Existing authoritative registry state must not be silently overwritten by initialization.
Listing is a recovery aid and must not validate every Hub before reporting registry state.
A valid registry must remain inspectable even when active selection is missing or malformed.
Unsafe registry rows must not be treated as authoritative targets.
Healthy switch validates the requested target including approval/compatibility at the final commit boundary.
When registry rows are valid but active metadata is broken, switch recovery is target-driven and must not require the old active selection.
Do not require old active Hub health; validate requested healthy target.
Do not require old active Hub health; validate requested healthy target.
A missing inactive row must never become active; another healthy row remains selectable.
A corrupt inactive row must never become active; another healthy row remains selectable.
Non-approved CURRENT is not activation-eligible.
Hub/CURRENT mismatch cannot become active.
Single-instance binding validates requested Hub target directly.
In registry mode Bind is an explicit target operation: a new identity may be registered, while an existing identity at a changed path is a rebind, not a conflicting duplicate.
Valid registry rows remain recoverable when only active selection metadata is broken.
Rebind must remain reachable when the old active Hub is missing.
Rebind must remain reachable when the old active Hub is corrupt.
A bind/rebind target with non-approved CURRENT cannot become authoritative.
A bind/rebind target with mismatched identity cannot become authoritative.
Register only activation-eligible exact staged state; preserve durable state after commit.
Coherent CANDIDATE/non-approved CURRENT cannot be durably registered.
Mismatched Hub/CURRENT cannot be durably registered.
Registered Genesis separates cancellation/staging/publication/commit and validates at boundaries.
The old Manager may not understand new parameters; handoff must survive version boundary or new Manager must fail closed.
Hub update cannot target a missing active Hub; use recovery switch/bind first.
Hub update cannot target an invalid active Hub; use recovery switch/bind first.
Global Manager update and Hub phase are distinct; missing Hub cannot be silently retargeted.
Global Manager update and Hub phase are distinct; corrupt Hub cannot be silently retargeted.
Legacy/global Hub inputs must not remain silently unreachable while instance workflows proceed as though inbox state were clean.
Candidate workflow must surface stranded global inputs rather than silently operate only on instance inbox.
Candidate workflow must surface stranded global transport inputs rather than silently operate only on instance inbox.
Doctor must surface legacy/global Hub-owned inputs that registered workflows will not consume.
Normal registered Hub update consumes only the captured instance-owned inbox.
Build candidate transport uses active captured instance CURRENT/inbox.
Restore candidate transport uses active captured instance CURRENT/inbox.
Never roll back proven durable registry state because post-commit verification failed.
Do not layer another selection mutation on ambiguous/unverified durable state.
Do not layer another registry mutation on ambiguous/unverified durable state.
Do not layer another registry mutation on ambiguous/unverified durable state.
Do not layer a rebind/registration mutation on ambiguous or unverified registry state.
